id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying a stale view schema mismatch

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion reliability: distinguishes permanent schema incompatibility from transient connection failures, preventing unnecessary warehouse restarts and guiding users to recreate views.
review.reason: Adds a new non-retryable error classification for Databricks incompatible view schema changes and a corresponding unit test. This prevents the ingestion system from treating permanent compatibility failures as transient connection errors, thereby avoiding unnecessary warehouse restarts and providing clearer remediation instructions. The implementation and test are visible, justifiy
review.uncertainty: The actual production impact and frequency of this specific Databricks schema incompatibility are not established by the code alone; this is a capability improvement rather than a response to an observed incident.
